description: One deterministic Signature-line app. The full record is derived client-side from (family, seed, id) by the Signature app engine (code/appgen.js); the archive index stores only compact rows [id, family, seed, name, tagline]. Same (family, seed) always yields the same record.

browser_demo.description: WORKING: a live interactive demo of this app's core function runs in the browser.

demo_mode.description: The demo runs on the user's device; no network calls.

demo_scope.description: The browser experience is a working demo of the app class, not a full production application.

python_companion.description: Python source download for the app's core function.

record.description: The record re-solves byte-identically from (family, seed).

thumbdrive_pack.description: .zip pack (app + python + spec + readme) for thumbdrive / CD-ROM.

app_version.description: Latest app version, e.g. "2.0". See versions[] for history.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical solved record JSON. Recomputable in-browser via the VERIFY control.

creation_mode.description: How the record came to exist. All archive apps are SIGNATURE-GENERATED.

demo.description: Demo renderer key in the DEMOS registry (code/demos.js).

family.description: Category key, one of the 30 permanent families (e.g. "word").

features.description: 8 features drawn from the family's feature pool.

id.description: Permanent app ID. Never reused, never changed. Retired records become tombstones.

lineage.description: Original Signature-line work by Justin Addam Higgins; inspired by the app class, copying no product, brand, or design.

privacy.description: Data-local statement: downloads are built locally in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

engine_version.description: Short SHA-256 of the engine that solved this record.

purpose.description: What the app is for, in plain words.

seed.description: Deterministic seed. Same (family, seed) always makes this exact app.

versions.description: Version history. Records are deterministic; versions describe the app's release lineage.
